packageRules.description: One weekly PR for every devDependency update. Individually they are noise; as a batch they are one review with one CI run.
Auto-merge patch, pin and digest updates to devDependencies once CI is green. Tooling patches are where the update cost exceeds the review value.
GitHub Action digests are pinned by P0-06 and kept fresh here. Safe to auto-merge: the digest is verified against the tag Renovate resolved it from.
Never auto-merge a major. A major is a behaviour change by definition, and the whole value of the gate is that a human reads the changelog.

Never auto-merge anything packages/security depends on, at any update level. Note: this matches nothing until that package declares its own dependencies, since they all currently live in the root manifest — the rule is here so it is already in place on the day it starts to matter.
